query: INSERT INTO solar_data_tsdb (time, current_kwh, today_kwh, month_kwh, total_kwh, raw_data) SELECT v.time, v.current_kwh, v.today_kwh, v.month_kwh, v.total_kwh, $6 FROM unnest($1::timestamptz[], $2::float8[], $3::float8[], $4::float8[], $5::float8[]) AS v(time, current_kwh, today_kwh, month_kwh, total_kwh)
